name: Mika Alestaid Heine
original_name: ミカ アルステッド ハイネ
source:
A love angel, it's her job to help people who are in love. She has a ring around her neck that glows when someone nearby is in love. She runs in to Satoru and joins his school to help him fall in love and win the girl of his dreams.

She has the ability to fly and change into a dove.
